'''Hextal''' was a [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] living during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> Around [[3641 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|Belsavis}}</ref> Hextal was stationed in the [[High Security Section]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], where he was assigned to track Imperial communications. In his sweeps, he pinpointed a looping transmission from the [[Ancient Prison Caverns]] and sent prison warden droids to retrieve the passkey needed to bypass the frequency. The droids reported success, but were soon overran by [[Esh-kha]] and dismantled, so Hextal was forced to ask a Republic representative in the area to retrieve the passkey from the droids manually.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Hextal appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Belsavis, where he begins the mission "Open Communications".
